info.title: Mobly Móveis & Decoração Open API
info.description:
Mobly REST API (version v0).

- JSON-based
- Authenticated via API key
- Versioned under `/v0`

remoteIds.description: Remote IDs for this lead in external integrations.

remoteId.description: Remote ID to set/clear for a specific integration. If omitted, existing remote IDs remain unchanged.

id.description: Remote ID value. Set to null to clear.

created.description: Whether a new record was created (false if matched by eventUrl).

potentialDuplicates.description: Existing events with matching name + startDate.

List industry events. Supports filtering by URL or full-text search.

- `eventUrl` — return only the event matching this exact URL
- `q` — full-text search across name, venueCity, venueState, venueCountry, description, keywords, industries, personas

If `eventUrl` is provided, `q` is ignored. If neither is provided, all industry events are returned (paginated).

---
📍 **Origem:** OpenAPI / Swagger Oficial Nativo (`openapi_gitbook_com_o_jaPKDvV3e46vsYDXzb4V_spec_mobly-rest-api-v0_yaml_174f63d8.json`)

post.description:
Create an industry event with automatic deduplication:

1. If an event with the same `eventUrl` already exists, the existing record is returned (`created: false`).
2. If no URL match but `name` and `startDate` match, the event is still created but `potentialDuplicates` are returned.

---
